# Real Estate & Property — First-Party Image Asset Register

**Register date:** 2026-11-08  
**Asset delivery:** Original inline SVG artwork generated by the first-party WordPress Studio storefront runtime  
**Generator:** `storefront.js → propertyArtSrc(assetId, scene)`  
**External image sources:** 0  
**External image destinations:** 0

The image count is based on meaningful image placements, not icons, logos, UI glyphs or decorative textures. Each page has a page-specific set of image IDs. No source illustration is reused between pages or templates.

## Per-image register fields

Every image is stored in the matching page record at:

`builder.template_pages.page_spec.media.images[]`

Each record includes:

- `id`: unique asset ID, e.g. `re-estate-luxe-home-01`;
- `alt`: descriptive alternative text;
- `scene`: scene family used by the original-art generator;
- `purpose`: page-specific visual purpose;
- `source`: original first-party procedural SVG generated by the WordPress Studio storefront runtime;
- `creator`: WordPress Studio design engine;
- `license`: original in-house generated artwork; no third-party license required;
- `attribution`: not required;
- `assetPath`: `inline:propertyArtSrc/<asset-id>`;
- `dateChecked`: 2026-11-08.

## Unique ID convention

`re-<template-key>-<page-key>-<sequence>`

The homepage sequence is 01–05. Every non-homepage page uses 01–02. The template prefix ensures that even equivalent page types in different designs have separate image IDs and separately generated artwork.

## Scene families

The original vector-art system supports architectural exteriors, residential interiors, kitchens, landscaped gardens, city skylines, neighbourhood maps and streetscapes, parks, commercial offices, floor-plan diagrams, retail frontage, land/aerial context, development construction scenes, shared amenities, property outlooks, architectural blueprints and accessibility routes.

## Rights and navigation

- No third-party photograph, stock-provider image URL or external hotlink is used in this asset set.
- The SVG art is generated by the website runtime and delivered as an inline data URI; it does not navigate to or load from another website.
- Clickable image wrappers are authored through the same-site `pageUrl()` helper and route to internal property, project, neighbourhood or enquiry pages.
- External image URLs are rejected by the real-estate template page-catalog validation.
- The source, creator, license, attribution, render path and check date are recorded with each asset.

## QA evidence

The Neon verification query returned, for each of the four templates:

- 40 active page records;
- 83 image placements;
- exactly 5 homepage images;
- exactly 2 images on each inner page;
- 83 unique image IDs;
- no duplicate image IDs across the four templates;
- 0 external HTTP(S) image sources;
- 83 image records with complete asset-register metadata.

This is an original illustration set for the template preview and structure. It is not a library of verified photographs of real properties. Replace or supplement the artwork with rights-cleared property photography when a merchant supplies approved property imagery, while preserving the page-level image caps and unique-asset rules.
